title: Key dates and limitation configuration
description: Tenant configuration for key dates. Owned by the core. Unknown keys are rejected. Changes are additive within a major version.

enabled.description: Feature flag for the key dates module.

defaults.description: Tenant-wide defaults. Each matter type can override these.

verification.description: Default two-step verification policy when not overridden by a matter type.

calendarSync.description: Default external calendar sync policy when not overridden by a matter type.

reminderScheduleId.description: Schedule used when a key date type does not name one.

teamAssignment.description: How the team diary is chosen for a new key date. Users with keydate:edit can change it.

x-reserved.reason: Reserved for backlog item F19 (Key dates team assignment modes beyond matter_owning_team).

keyDateTypes.description: Types of key date available to users.

items.description: Definition of a single key date type.

id.description: Unique stable identifier for the key date type.

label.description: Human-readable display label for the key date type.

category.description: High-level classification category for the key date type.

defaultCritical.description: Whether new key dates of this type default to critical status.

allowManualEntry.description: Whether users may manually enter a due date for this key date type.

allowCalculation.description: Offer the rule-based calculator for this type.

active.description: Whether this key date type is active and selectable for new records.

matterTypes.description: Per matter type settings. Matter types not listed use the defaults.

items.description: Key date rules and policies for a specific matter type.

matterTypeId.description: ID from the tenant's existing matter type list.

requiredKeyDateTypeIds.description: Key date types that must be added, or recorded as not applicable with a reason, before the matter can open.

allowNotApplicable.description: Whether users may record a required key date type as not applicable with a reason.

blockClosureWithOpenDates.description: Whether matter closure is blocked while unresolved key dates remain on the matter.

defaultRuleSetIds.description: Limitation rule set IDs offered by default for matters of this type.

x-reserved.reason: Reserved for backlog item F19 (Default limitation rule set filtering by matter type).

verification.description: Matter-type override for the two-step verification policy.

calendarSync.description: Matter-type override for the external calendar sync policy.

reminderSchedules.description: Stages advance ONE reminder task per key date. A later stage updates the existing task; it never creates another.

items.description: Definition of a staged reminder schedule.

id.description: Unique stable identifier for the reminder schedule.

label.description: Human-readable display name for the reminder schedule.

stages.description: Ordered stages at which the single reminder task is advanced.

items.description: Single stage threshold within a reminder schedule.

daysBefore.description: Number of calendar days before the due date at which this stage triggers.

priority.description: Task priority assigned when the reminder enters this stage.

escalation.description: Escalation rules when a reminder stage remains unacknowledged.

afterUnacknowledgedDays.description: Number of days a reminder stage can remain unacknowledged before escalating.

levels.description: In order. 'team_leads' = leads of the key date's team; 'role:<roleKey>' = holders of that role.

limitationRuleSets.description: Firm-owned rule sets. The core ships no statutory periods. Dates calculated from an unreviewed rule set are flagged and cannot skip verification.

id.description: Unique stable identifier for the limitation rule set.

version.description: Monotonically increasing version number for the rule set.

label.description: Human-readable name of the limitation rule set.

jurisdiction.description: Legal jurisdiction to which this limitation rule set applies.

reviewStatus.description: Whether the firm's compliance reviewer has approved this rule set version.

reviewedBy.description: Name or person ID of the reviewing solicitor.

reviewedOn.description: ISO date on which the rule set was reviewed and approved.

rules.description: Individual limitation calculation rules within this rule set.

businessCalendars.description: Non-working days used for business-day counting and adjustments.

items.description: Business calendar defining weekends and bank holidays.

id.description: Unique stable identifier for the business calendar.

label.description: Human-readable label for the business calendar.

nonWorkingDates.description: List of ISO calendar dates treated as non-working bank or public holidays.

source.description: Whether non-working dates were entered manually or imported.

calendarSync.description: Provider settings. Whether sync happens is set by defaults.calendarSync and matter type overrides.

x-reserved.reason: Reserved for backlog item F19 (Multi-provider external calendar adapter selection).

targets.description: Calendar targets that receive synchronised key date events.

eventTitleTemplate.description: Allowed tokens: matterReference, keyDateTypeLabel, title, category. No client names by default.

includeMatterDescription.description: Whether non-restricted matter descriptions may be included in calendar event bodies.

statusesToSync.description: Key date statuses that are synchronised to external calendars.

teamCalendarMappings.description: Mappings between internal team IDs and Microsoft 365 group calendar IDs.

teamId.description: Internal team ID in the tenant store.

groupId.description: Microsoft 365 group ID. Not a secret; credentials are by Key Vault reference only.

verificationOverdueDays.description: Number of calendar days after proposal before an unverified key date is flagged as overdue.

criticalNoActivityDays.description: Number of days without matter activity before an upcoming critical key date raises an exception.

criticalNoActivityWindowDays.description: Only check activity on critical dates due within this many days.

permissions.description: Role-to-permission grant mappings for the key dates module.

roleGrants.description: Maps role keys (HomeRoleKey or AppRole) to key date permissions.

id.description: Lowercase alphanumeric identifier with optional underscores, dots, or hyphens.

verificationPolicy.description: Two-step verification. A second person with keydate:verify must confirm before the date is live.

required.description: Whether second-person verification is required before a key date is confirmed.

appliesTo.description: Subset of key dates to which the verification requirement applies.

calendarSyncPolicy.description: Policy controlling whether key dates synchronise to external calendars.

enabled.description: On by default. Restricted (staff) matters never sync.

limitationRule.description: Single limitation calculation rule within a rule set.

id.description: Unique stable identifier for the limitation rule.

label.description: Human-readable title of the limitation rule.

claimType.description: Optional category or cause-of-action label for the rule.

x-reserved.reason: Reserved for backlog item F19 (Claim-type classification and filtering on limitation rules).

guidanceNote.description: Shown in the calculator. Not legal advice.

trigger.description: Trigger date selector (single trigger field or later-of multiple trigger fields).

kind.description: Uses a single trigger date field.

field.description: Trigger field key from which the limitation period starts.

oneOf.description: Later of two or more trigger date fields.

kind.description: Selects the latest date among the specified trigger fields.

fields.description: Candidate trigger fields compared to determine the latest start date.

period.description: Duration added to the effective trigger date.

countMethod.description: Method used to count the period from the trigger date.

calendarId.description: Business calendar for counting and adjustment.

nonWorkingDayAdjustment.description: Adjustment applied when the calculated date falls on a weekend or non-working holiday.

minorityAdjustment.description: Adjustment delaying the start of time until the claimant reaches majority.

enabled.description: Whether minority postponement is enabled for this rule.

ageOfMajority.description: Age in years at which the claimant reaches majority.

applyStandstillPeriods.description: Whether standstill agreement periods extend the calculated limitation date.

longstop.description: Optional overriding longstop ceiling measured from a specified trigger field.

field.description: Trigger date field from which the longstop period is measured.

triggerField.description: Built-in or custom trigger date field key.

period.description: Calendar or working period expressed in years, months, and days.

years.description: Number of whole years in the period.

months.description: Number of whole calendar months in the period.

days.description: May be negative, e.g. -1 for 'less one day'.
